native.query:
SELECT 
    SUBSTR(l.name, 1, 6) AS version, c.status AS consent_status, COUNT(*) AS `count`
FROM consent c
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        broadcast.name, contact_id, MAX(created_at) latest 
    FROM broadcast
    JOIN broadcast_link link ON link.broadcast_id=broadcast.id
    JOIN source s ON s.id = link.source_id
    JOIN consent ON consent.source_id=s.id
    WHERE {{broadcast_test_id}}
    GROUP BY broadcast.id, contact_id
) l ON l.contact_id=c.contact_id AND l.latest=c.created_at
GROUP BY version, consent_status
